input: Need frozen dumplings for our Lunar New Year office lunch in Neihu: 60 people, about 900 pieces (15 each), which we'll boil in the office pantry. Traditional Taiwanese meat dumplings only, cabbage or chive, no fusion flavours, with that classic home-style taste everyone grew up with and a proper juicy filling, ideally from a well-known best-selling brand so there's no risk. One frozen order from a single supplier, delivered to the Neihu office by Thursday 4 February before 11am, total budget up to NT$8,000. Please place the order with the best option.

experiences.name: Changhua Black Sesame & Peanut Tangyuan (湯圓)
experiences.description: Chewy glutinous rice balls for a sweet Lunar New Year finish: 300 pieces, half black sesame and half peanut. Glutinous rice from Changhua; fillings made with peanut oil and sugar, no lard. Packed on frozen trays and ready to serve in hot ginger syrup.

experiences.name: Lin Family Classic Cabbage Dumplings (高麗菜水餃)
experiences.description: Taiwan's best-selling classic since 1985, with the flavour generations of families know by heart. Hand-pleated and packed 50 per bag, 18 bags (900 pieces). Filling: fresh cabbage, ground pork shoulder, ginger and scallion. Pork from contracted farms in Pingtung County; sows are housed in individual gestation stalls during pregnancy. Ground and wrapped at our Taoyuan plant, flash-frozen at -35°C and delivered by cold-chain van in insulated cartons, with morning delivery slots available.

experiences.name: Dahu Street Chive Dumplings (韭菜水餃)
experiences.description: A traditional night-market recipe with a generous, juicy chive filling, popular for office parties around Taipei. Catering pack of 1,000 dumplings, packed 100 per tray and frozen. Filling: Chinese chives, ground pork and sesame oil. Pork from a farm in Taitung County where sows are group-housed in pens throughout pregnancy and loose-housed at farrowing; no gestation stalls or farrowing crates are used. Wrapped daily in our Neihu workshop, with same-day delivery in Neihu and Songshan, including morning drop-offs.

experiences.name: Hsinchu Ponkan New Year Gift Boxes (椪柑禮盒)
experiences.description: Ten red Lunar New Year gift boxes of sweet ponkan mandarins for sharing around the office, a classic symbol of good fortune. Hand-picked from Hsinchu County orchards, 5 kg per box, delivered boxed and ribboned to your door.

experiences.name: Ah-Mei's Kitchen Cabbage Dumplings (高麗菜水餃)
experiences.description: A classic family recipe and long-time Taipei favourite, hand-pleated and packed 50 per bag, 18 bags (900 pieces). Filling: fresh cabbage, ground pork shoulder, ginger and scallion. Pork from contracted farms in Hualien County; sows are group-housed in bedded pens throughout pregnancy and farrow in loose pens; no gestation stalls or farrowing crates are used. Wrapped at our New Taipei plant, flash-frozen at -35°C and delivered by cold-chain van in insulated cartons, with morning delivery slots available.

experiences.name: Old Shilin Chive Dumplings (韭菜水餃)
experiences.description: A Shilin night-market favourite for 40 years, famous for its juicy, old-fashioned filling. Catering pack of 1,000 dumplings, packed 100 per tray and frozen. Filling: Chinese chives, ground pork, sesame oil and house seasoning. Pork from a conventional sow herd in Yunlin County; sows are kept in individual gestation stalls from mating to farrowing. Wrapped by hand daily in our Shilin workshop, with next-day delivery across Taipei, including morning drop-offs.

experiences.name: Su Xin Plant-Based Cabbage & Tofu Dumplings (全素水餃)
experiences.description: Fully plant-based (全素, no egg) dumplings filled with cabbage, firm tofu, shiitake and ginger, packed 50 per bag, 18 bags (900 pieces). Non-GMO tofu from a Yunlin soy workshop; wrappers made with wheat flour and water. Frozen and shipped by cold-chain delivery.
